stories.title: Contract/toolchain baseline
stories.implementation: Pin the Rust and architecture-check Python toolchains with lockfiles; add one reproducible local/CI check command; build a minimal litecoworkd CLI supporting help/version only. Defer Node/TypeScript/pnpm pins to E02-S01; do not start a listener, open storage, or launch an agent.
stories.acceptance: A clean checkout runs scripts/check.sh with exact pinned versions, Rust format/lint/test/build, Python fixture tests, and both contract validators. CLI help/version succeed and unsupported options fail. No operational Runtime behavior is claimed.
stories.negative_cases: Missing or mismatched pinned toolchain, malformed JSON schema fixture, unsupported CLI option.
stories.demo: Run scripts/check.sh in a clean checkout, then run cargo run --locked -p litecoworkd -- --help and cargo run --locked -p litecoworkd -- --version on the reference development OS.

stories.title: Transactional persistence
stories.implementation: Implement domain/store ports and SQLite write executor, event+aggregate transactions, blobs/digests, migrations and projection replay; run SP02.
stories.acceptance: Concurrent expected-version writes have one winner; interrupted writes leave neither half-event nor partial head; projections rebuild identically.
stories.negative_cases: Disk full, busy timeout, missing FK/trigger, migration crash, corrupt blob.
stories.demo: Create a Workspace, restart storage, rebuild projections and compare digests.

stories.title: Independent Runtime lifecycle
stories.implementation: Implement single-instance/incarnation boot, recovery, shutdown/drain, startup policy, sleep/wake and service packaging skeleton.
stories.acceptance: Closing Operator leaves daemon running; reboot changes incarnation; stale process cannot own a lease; workers lazy-start.
stories.negative_cases: Duplicate startup, SIGKILL, sleep during write, invalid state directory permissions.
stories.demo: Close app, reopen, kill daemon, recover same durable records.

stories.title: Authenticated Operator boundary
stories.implementation: Implement scoped authenticated Operator API, RequestId dedupe, error envelopes, event subscription cursors/backpressure and generated TS client; run SP03.
stories.acceptance: Replay returns same command result; another origin/unauthenticated process denied; reconnect fills missed events before live updates.
stories.negative_cases: Malformed ID, cross-Workspace request, reused RequestId with changed payload, slow stream.
stories.demo: Use desktop client and adversarial HTTP client against same daemon.

stories.title: Desktop shell/onboarding
stories.implementation: Tauri React shell, theme tokens, routes, keyboard navigation, primary empty states, daemon connection/tray; run SP01.
stories.acceptance: Fresh install creates local Workspace; no fake worker card; daemon offline is explicit; native shell survives reconnect.
stories.negative_cases: Webview missing, daemon unavailable, repeated submit, resize/200% zoom.
stories.demo: Install on reference OS, create Workspace and close/reopen Operator.

stories.title: Workspace policy and instructions
stories.implementation: Implement Workspace create/revise/archive, replication policy, roots, versioned instructions and optimistic concurrency.
stories.acceptance: Tasks pin instructions; archive cannot strand active authority; local-only is default; stale editor gets conflict.
stories.negative_cases: Root escapes, overlapping roots, offline policy edit, archive with active Task.
stories.demo: Create two Workspaces and prove isolated instructions and search.

stories.title: Resource intake and factual index
stories.implementation: Implement resumable uploads, file/folder selection, immutable revisions/ancestry, identity/freshness watchers and deterministic FTS search.
stories.acceptance: Cancel/restart upload resumes verified chunks; rename preserves correct identity; search metadata does not silently attach content.
stories.negative_cases: Symlink/TOCTOU, duplicate digest, deleted root, watcher overflow, unsupported encoding.
stories.demo: Import a project folder, rename/edit files, search and inspect exact revisions.

stories.title: Needs You and truthful UI state
stories.implementation: Derived inbox for Approval/UserRequest/blockers, stable routing, stale action protection; implement motion after committed states only.
stories.acceptance: Resolving source removes one item; activity and verified Evidence labels differ; no token heartbeat implies completion.
stories.negative_cases: Duplicate event, already-resolved item, unauthorized notification click, reduced motion.
stories.demo: Create two blockers, resolve one, replay event and observe unchanged inbox.

stories.title: Harness qualification and bindings
stories.implementation: Run SP04; probe supported native descriptor/config digest/session options; implement discovery, auth readiness, enabled and lead_eligible.
stories.acceptance: Native config remains unchanged; unsupported overrides rejected; installed/connected/lead eligibility displayed independently.
stories.negative_cases: Missing binary, expired auth, config drift, unavailable model, plugin conflict.
stories.demo: Compare selected native agent with LiteCowork launched session using same config.

stories.title: Conversation turns
stories.implementation: Implement visible messages/turns, input steering, provider UserRequests, scope-specific sessions and cancel/retry.
stories.acceptance: Ordinary chat creates no Task/Attempt; concurrent input lands at supported boundary; secrets never enter messages.
stories.negative_cases: Turn retry/replay, crash after output before settlement, oversized attachment.
stories.demo: Ask a quick question, interrupt, restart and inspect visible conversation.

stories.title: Planning and atomic plan acceptance
stories.implementation: Implement TaskSpec revisions, attempt-free PlanningAssignment, accepted PlanRevision/Steps transaction and user steering.
stories.acceptance: No Attempt before accepted Step; stale plans refused; criteria and resources pinned; changed intent creates revision.
stories.negative_cases: Concurrent acceptance, invalid DAG, missing capability, stale TaskSpec, plan crash.
stories.demo: Request repo review, inspect durable plan and accepted Steps.

stories.title: Attempt execution and recovery
stories.implementation: Implement scheduler/admission/lease, AttemptRunner, bounded TaskPacket/ResumePacket, checkpoint, pause/cancel and recovery ladder.
stories.acceptance: Worker kill creates replacement Attempt with same Task; unresolved Effects reconciled before retry; cancel prevents fresh admissions.
stories.negative_cases: Crash during checkpoint, stale epoch, pause during verification, lost environment.
stories.demo: Kill running worker, resume Task and compare completed/unresolved Steps.

stories.title: Native feature conformance
stories.implementation: Qualify resume, native subagents, worktrees, MCP/skills/hooks/plugins/compaction per adapter; add adapter protocol recordings and real runs.
stories.acceptance: Native children stay harness-owned; feature matrix has proven/unsupported/provider-dependent cells; native private state not replicated.
stories.negative_cases: Background native child, handle expiry, option change, hook modifies output.
stories.demo: Run native-feature suite outside and inside host and report actual differences.

stories.title: Trust evaluation and credential boundary
stories.implementation: Implement PolicyEngine/Approval/grants/SecretLease/credential/egress ports under TrustService; OS secret store integration.
stories.acceptance: Approval != grant; delegated authority cannot exceed parent; secrets injected only at authorized boundary; audit redacted.
stories.negative_cases: Approval replay, SSRF/DNS rebinding, expired SecretLease, malicious tool input.
stories.demo: Prepare a connector action, deny/approve it and inspect audit without secret bytes.

stories.title: Gateway and progressive discovery
stories.implementation: Implement authenticated litecowork gateway tools, scoped catalogue/activation, capability locks, host sharing/circuits and direct-path qualification.
stories.acceptance: Only enabled authorized capabilities discovered; every call checks grant/fence; unsafe direct path uses Gateway.
stories.negative_cases: Forged session, package metadata injection, host crash, circuit-open provider.
stories.demo: Discover and activate a deterministic read capability then revoke access.

stories.title: Invocation/Effect reconciliation
stories.implementation: Implement durable asynchronous Invocation state, provider input, per-action Effect/idempotency, reconciliation and execution-method provenance.
stories.acceptance: Lost reply never blindly duplicates mutation; ambiguous state blocks; method persisted honestly; await/cancel recover after session loss.
stories.negative_cases: Timeout after send, provider duplicate callback, stale fence, unsupported sensitive input.
stories.demo: Send to local test mailbox, drop response, reconcile exactly one external result.

stories.title: Real LiteSPM and MCP conformance
stories.implementation: Implement internal port with fixtures; obtain configured LiteSPM authority; qualify real package/component/MCP_SKILL activation/update/pin behavior.
stories.acceptance: Fixture and real results separate; exact package digest pinned; active Task survives update; no invented service endpoint/API.
stories.negative_cases: Unknown wire contract, incompatible manifest, untrusted package, package restart storm.
stories.demo: Use one real resolved package end to end or record integration BLOCKED.

stories.title: Artifact/Evidence/verifier completion
stories.implementation: Artifact versions/provenance, Evidence strength, VerificationRuns, dependency invalidation, CompletionEvaluator and budgeted verifier failures.
stories.acceptance: Agent said done cannot satisfy criterion; changed source invalidates evidence; verifier uses exact candidate version and independent oracle.
stories.negative_cases: Corrupt artifact, stale test output, malicious verifier hint, cancel during verify.
stories.demo: Produce diff/report, independently check it and show verified versus reported status.

stories.title: DelegationProfile lifecycle and UI
stories.implementation: Versioned profile CRUD/duplicate/enable/archive, adapter option validation and Coworker assignment UI; same binding multiple profiles.
stories.acceptance: Disabled by default including lead; revision pin never mutates running child; enable starts no process.
stories.negative_cases: Enable disconnected agent, stale profile edit, archived binding, unsupported model.
stories.demo: Create fast and reviewer profiles on one installed harness.

stories.title: Child admission and isolation
stories.implementation: Accepted-Step host delegation, parent-child provenance, depth/concurrency reservations, TaskPacket/ResultEnvelope validation, private worktrees.
stories.acceptance: No child Attempt for native children; host child has own lease/grants/budget; shared writers denied by default.
stories.negative_cases: Recursion, admission race, parent cancel, cross-Task packet, conflicting worktree diff.
stories.demo: Lead delegates repository scan/edit to second harness and same-harness worker.

stories.title: Routing and measured cost
stories.implementation: Hard-filter then deterministic rank; unknown-cost semantics, BudgetReservations, quota observations, performance projection and explicit profile preference.
stories.acceptance: Unknown != zero; explicit profile never silently substitutes; quality floor constrains cheap-first; reproducible rank reasons.
stories.negative_cases: Cost estimate stale, quota unknown, exhausted account, tied candidates, budget reservation race.
stories.demo: Compare low-cost and quality-first choices on same bounded task.

stories.title: Verification escalation and lead failover
stories.implementation: Bounded new-Attempt escalation; policy-pinned lead failover with fresh lead eligibility/Trust/auth checks and portable handoff.
stories.acceptance: Failed verifier creates new immutable Attempt; quota exhaustion triggers only allowed policy; active children remain coherently tracked.
stories.negative_cases: Failover race, unavailable fallback, infinite retry, TaskSpec changes during child result.
stories.demo: Inject failed cheap result then quota exhaustion; show bounded escalation/handoff.

stories.title: Harness breadth and efficiency benchmark
stories.implementation: Qualify Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Cline adapters where real interfaces permit; measure premium-only vs cheap-workforce outcomes.
stories.acceptance: Supported profiles prove native strengths; publish usage/cost/retries/verified-success and human rescues, no invented multiplier.
stories.negative_cases: Unreported quota/cost, unsupported Cline host feature, provider rate-limit bursts.
stories.demo: Run same code task corpus with baseline and delegated policy.

stories.title: Bounded archive and extraction provider
stories.implementation: ZIP manifest preview and extraction limits; isolated type parsing/OCR provider; exact Resource revisions and parse provenance; run SP06.
stories.acceptance: Path traversal/symlinks/bombs refused; original immutable; PDF/page/table references retained; failures visible per file.
stories.negative_cases: Nested ZIP, encrypted ZIP, Unicode duplicate path, zip bomb, malformed PDF, OCR timeout.
stories.demo: Import mixed folder and ZIP without escape; inspect extraction report.

stories.title: Hybrid retrieval and grounded attachments
stories.implementation: Provider chunk/embedding/rerank index with ACL filters, revision/digest references, quotas, bounded query and citation resolution.
stories.acceptance: Only authorized current/pinned content attached; exact page/span citation opens; no evidence gives explicit insufficient answer.
stories.negative_cases: Prompt injection, poisoned chunks, no relevant hit, outdated vector model, cross-Workspace leak.
stories.demo: Answer gold questions across 20 PDFs and a code folder with checked citations.

stories.title: Incremental update/delete recovery
stories.implementation: Delta indexing/watch overflow reconciliation, source revision invalidation, provider-owned replica registration and purge receipts.
stories.acceptance: Changed file invalidates stale index; revoked source blocked immediately; DELETED waits exact receipt set; index rebuild from authorized sources.
stories.negative_cases: Offline provider, crash between chunk and index commit, deletion during query, renamed source.
stories.demo: Edit then revoke/delete source and prove absence in fresh query/context.

stories.title: Local-model harness UX and performance
stories.implementation: Run SP05; integrate qualified harness with local engine; endpoint/auth/model status, bounded context, tool tests, cancellation, warm hints and egress policy.
stories.acceptance: Airplane-mode test completes with local parsing/embedding/inference when configured; model limits explicit; Core never becomes reasoning loop.
stories.negative_cases: OOM, no GPU, cold load, context overflow, stalled stream, tool call unsupported.
stories.demo: Run cited document task and coding edit on two recorded hardware profiles.

stories.title: Knowledge UI and placement
stories.implementation: Upload/folder/ZIP progress, extraction errors, index ready/stale states, citation viewer, source scope, retention and local/cloud availability.
stories.acceptance: Uploading != searchable; embedding egress shown; local-only resource blocks cloud resolution; reindex/cancel retry are actionable.
stories.negative_cases: Partial folder permissions, removed drive, disconnected provider, repeated submit.
stories.demo: Drag a ZIP, inspect readiness and citation, attempt disallowed cloud task.

stories.title: Persistent environment management
stories.implementation: Provider classes/lifetime/sharing, provisioning preview/idempotency/recovery, budgets, suspending/destroying and cleanup.
stories.acceptance: Private worktree vs retained browser semantics separate; no secret locator in events; persistent cost/ownership explicit.
stories.negative_cases: Provisioning response loss, unhealthy environment, archive with reference, budget exceed.
stories.demo: Prepare isolated checkout and retained container; restart and reuse safely.

stories.title: Structured browser and control leases
stories.implementation: Qualified API/DOM/accessibility/browser providers, browser auth separation, control epochs, observations and human takeover.
stories.acceptance: One input actor; queued stale actions discarded; returning to agent captures fresh state; exact execution method recorded.
stories.negative_cases: Control race, auth expiry, stale selector, malicious page, CAPTCHA, user edits form.
stories.demo: Fill a sandbox form, take over, change it and return with new epoch.

stories.title: ActionBatch/deadline/warm lifecycle
stories.implementation: Bounded per-member invocations/effects, preconditions/abort/fallback, deadline preflight; WarmHold TTL/pressure eviction/config recheck.
stories.acceptance: Batch not transaction; partial success reconciled; no hard realtime; prewarm no model call; warm state no authority.
stories.negative_cases: Operation 3 fails after 1 sends, preflight stale, hold expiry, provider config drift.
stories.demo: Prewarm, perform timed nonfinal form preparation, fail one member and reconcile.

stories.title: Office/data/research capability qualification
stories.implementation: Integrate external office/research/data providers: editable XLSX/DOCX/PPTX/PDF, tables/chart/reports, partitioned data analysis.
stories.acceptance: Formula and rendered-layout checks independent; source/provenance pinned; generated code/capability is reviewed draft only.
stories.negative_cases: Broken formula, truncated CSV, bad font/export, malicious macro, hallucinated source.
stories.demo: Receipts to workbook/PDF and forecast to slides with recalculation/render verification.

stories.title: Desktop computer use and optional observation
stories.implementation: OS-specific qualified computer provider, isolated opt-in observation, screen capture permissions and privacy controls.
stories.acceptance: No screen capture on opening Quick Entry; observe only opted-in scope; unsupported OS/action surfaced, no bypass of site security.
stories.negative_cases: Screen lock, revoked permission, wrong window, sensitive region, action after takeover.
stories.demo: Operate permitted local app with keyboard takeover and recorded real activity.

stories.title: Coworker identity and Home
stories.implementation: Revisioned Coworker/default lead/interaction defaults/primary selection, presence, Home hierarchy and allowlist worker assignment.
stories.acceptance: Pause blocks new proactive work not existing Tasks; archive guards primary/responsibilities; named composer with advanced controls.
stories.negative_cases: Archived lead, multiple active Tasks, offline default path, stale assignment.
stories.demo: Create Alex, assign cheap workers, start two Tasks and inspect status.

stories.title: Goals and suggestion producers
stories.implementation: Passive Goal links/progress/reopen; bounded deterministic/provider producers with provenance, dedupe/cooldown/mute/snooze/expiry and accept flow.
stories.acceptance: Goal never executes; Suggestion accept makes reviewed Task/draft; max one prominent idea; producer cannot self-authorize.
stories.negative_cases: Duplicate proposal, stale source, snoozed/muted suggestion, goal archive race.
stories.demo: Link verified Tasks to goal, surface and accept/dismiss a provenance-backed idea.

stories.title: Editable context lifecycle
stories.implementation: ContextDocument editor, exact parent merge/conflict, revoke/delete tombstones/receipt saga; stop affected native sessions safely.
stories.acceptance: Lost edit not overwritten; revoked bytes not reattached; native history cannot be recalled and old session not reused.
stories.negative_cases: Two concurrent editors, purge target offline, revocation during context fetch, restore tombstone.
stories.demo: Edit profile twice concurrently, merge and delete with visible pending receipts.

stories.title: Live Desk/Workbench/Library/Inspector
stories.implementation: Outcome-first Work filters, actual worker tree/progress, rich artifact registry/sandboxed preview/edit versions, Library provenance, Inspector diagnostics.
stories.acceptance: Every lane/output tied to committed state/version; renderers isolated; dirty/version conflict explicit; advanced IDs not default flow.
stories.negative_cases: Late projection, malicious HTML preview, incompatible renderer, artifact edit conflict.
stories.demo: Open code diff, report and spreadsheet outputs; inspect evidence and worker tree.

stories.title: Interaction completeness and accessibility
stories.implementation: Every route empty/loading/offline/error/conflict/permission state; keyboard/search/Quick Entry; motion interruption/reduced motion/contrast/zoom.
stories.acceptance: All critical paths keyboard usable; live announcements throttled; no fake ETA/cost/progress; state transition only after actual event.
stories.negative_cases: Long text, 400% zoom, reduced motion, rapid state reversal, deep-link stale auth.
stories.demo: Owner completes task/approval/takeover solely by keyboard and reduced motion.

stories.title: Routine creation/revision and reusable work
stories.implementation: Create Routine from verified Task, typed inputs/criteria/pinned skills, revision lifecycle/health and reviewable extraction.
stories.acceptance: Incidental paths/secrets removed; Routine what differs from Skill how; dependencies/pins visible and edits future-only.
stories.negative_cases: Invalid input schema, drifted skill, unverified source task, archived routine.
stories.demo: Turn verified weekly research into parameterized Routine.

stories.title: Automation and occurrences
stories.implementation: Pinned Routine/Coworker Automation revisions, schedule/manual/webhook/file/poll/provider trigger conformance, cursor/misfire/dedupe/concurrency.
stories.acceptance: Every occurrence ordinary Task; edit never resets logical cursor; current Coworker ACTIVE checked; local unavailable waits.
stories.negative_cases: DST gap/fold, restart catch-up, duplicate webhook, no-change poll, cursor race.
stories.demo: Weekly local report across daemon restart and schedule edit without duplicate run.

stories.title: Automation test and health/drift UX
stories.implementation: Exact-revision test Task without real occurrence/cursor changes; create-preview-test-enable wizard, health projection and drift repair proposal.
stories.acceptance: Test can perform only authorized actions; no implicit dry-run fiction; enable separate; repair immutable draft revision.
stories.negative_cases: Failed test, stale revision on enable, broken source layout, auth revoked.
stories.demo: Test a saved routine, inspect health, simulate source drift and repair draft.

stories.title: Notifications and settings
stories.implementation: Outcome/blocker notifications, category preferences/quiet time/dedupe/delivery attempts, deep-links and independent task settlement.
stories.acceptance: Delivery success != Task completion; no alert per worker token/Step; owner can retry failed channel setup.
stories.negative_cases: Notification duplicate, OS permission denied, late delivery, secret in preview.
stories.demo: Complete Task with app closed; reopen correct Artifact from notification.

stories.title: MCP Apps/Skills and Discover
stories.implementation: Sandbox App frames/CSP/message bridge, MCP_SKILL manifest conformance, Discover status/grants/auth/install/version compatibility.
stories.acceptance: App cannot steal Operator credentials; exact-origin transport only; install metadata not authority; incompatible option disabled.
stories.negative_cases: Forged app message, CORS escape, hostile manifest, missing package service.
stories.demo: Render real compatible MCP App and deny out-of-scope tool action.

stories.title: Demonstration capture and SkillProposal
stories.implementation: Bounded semantic capture/pause/redaction, user review, typed placeholders, replay test/drift and explicit publication through real LiteSPM.
stories.acceptance: Secrets omitted; raw coordinates not sole authority; caps stop recording; draft cannot enable itself.
stories.negative_cases: 2FA/private screen, timeout/trace bound, replay drift, missing publish contract.
stories.demo: Teach sandbox browser task, review/test draft, approve package publication when qualified.

stories.title: Cloud deployment and operations
stories.implementation: Run SP07; deploy same daemon/container with persistent volume/health/resource limits/reverse proxy/TLS; use OpenClaw deployment references.
stories.acceptance: UI close does not stop cloud job; restart persists state; externally exposed control plane authenticated; cost caps documented.
stories.negative_cases: Container killed, volume loss, auth misconfig, disk full, sandbox escape.
stories.demo: Provision disposable server, run Task, restart and restore backup.

stories.title: Pairing, sync and conflict authority
stories.implementation: Device identity/trust/pairing/revocation, Hub-authoritative event sequence, bounded replication/artifact digests, scope/placement policy.
stories.acceptance: Only permitted domain events/blobs sync; no DB/native-private-state copy; revoked Runtime cannot reconnect/read new data.
stories.negative_cases: Out-of-order/duplicate event, corrupt blob, malicious device, offline intent conflict.
stories.demo: Pair laptop/cloud and replicate selected Task without local-only files.

stories.title: Handoff, failure and fencing
stories.implementation: Portable Task handoff/Effect reconcile/new Attempt/new epoch; explicit and policy-based failover; lease expiry and Hub-loss handling.
stories.acceptance: Partition never permits two consequential writers; ambiguous Effects reconciled first; local dependency waits honestly.
stories.negative_cases: Crash during handoff phases, stale epoch, Hub loss, sleep/clock skew, lost ACK.
stories.demo: Move eligible Task to cloud, kill link after mutation and recover without resend.

stories.title: Human channel integration
stories.implementation: One qualified Telegram/email adapter, identity/assurance/routing/binding, ingress receipts and outbound Effect delivery; OpenClaw patterns reference only.
stories.acceptance: Duplicate delivery idempotent; weak channel cannot authorize sensitive action; channel state not separate task DB.
stories.negative_cases: Spoofed identity, replayed reply, expired UserRequest, channel host failover.
stories.demo: Start/status/steer a Task from approved channel, finish Artifact on desktop.

stories.title: Cloud capability and security qualification
stories.implementation: Cloud/browser/secret injection/provider availability, resource staging, image updates/rollbacks, actual observability and multi-runtime backup drills.
stories.acceptance: Native sessions not teleported; portable resource manifest verified; costs/performance and provider restrictions published.
stories.negative_cases: Missing local app, no provider auth, revoke during upload, stale snapshot restore.
stories.demo: Close laptop for cloud-eligible work; local-app Task explicitly waits.

stories.title: Remote installation and enrollment
stories.implementation: Headless service package/bootstrap/health, pairing/grants/OS capability descriptor and revocation; no separate remote task engine.
stories.acceptance: Same API/domain semantics; remote files require explicit roots; service identity isolated; least-privilege enrollment documented.
stories.negative_cases: Unreachable host, wrong identity, outdated version, revoked principal.
stories.demo: Enroll second workstation/server and inspect its actual capabilities.

stories.title: Remote placement/continuation tests
stories.implementation: Resource freshness, environment/auth/dependency placement, remote leases and portable handoff with fencing.
stories.acceptance: Only eligible steps remote; results verified; local-only resources stay blocked; connectivity loss obeys recovery policy.
stories.negative_cases: Remote partition during Effect, host reboot, provider auth expires, worktree unavailable.
stories.demo: Execute code task remotely, disconnect mid-run and reconcile on reconnect.

stories.title: Backup/restore and safe upgrades
stories.implementation: Encrypted manifest backup, migration/restore to fresh Runtime, tombstone/purge receipt preservation, upgrades/rollback and in-progress pins.
stories.acceptance: Restored Runtime new identity; no old authority resurrected; resource/artifact checksums verified; incompatible downgrade refused.
stories.negative_cases: Interrupted backup, corrupt manifest, wrong key, schema mismatch, offline purge targets.
stories.demo: Restore actual Workspace on clean install then resume eligible Task.

stories.title: Performance/soak and resilience
stories.implementation: Measure idle/start/event/task/retrieval/provider latencies, memory/backpressure/load; freeze numeric SLOs from baseline then enforce regression.
stories.acceptance: No unbounded queues/process leak; long soak recovers injected faults; Core and provider latency separated.
stories.negative_cases: Many installed idle providers, million-row task, provider circuit storm, disk pressure.
stories.demo: Record desktop/cloud/remote benchmark and sustained-run report.

stories.title: Real workflow and platform release suite
stories.implementation: Run full coverage and real-use corpus on declared OS/adapter matrices; owner evaluates output fidelity, permissions and practical replacement.
stories.acceptance: Every assigned flow/benchmark has PASS/BLOCKED/NOT_APPLICABLE decision with evidence; blockers cannot quietly count as pass.
stories.negative_cases: Unsupported OS capability, provider drift, flaky test, missing signing hardware/account.
stories.demo: Owner repeats representative tasks from clean installers, not dev server.

stories.title: Packaging/security/runbooks and launch
stories.implementation: Signed supported installers, daemon service upgrades, SBOM/licenses/dependency scan, docs/privacy/support diagnostics/incident playbooks and release candidate.
stories.acceptance: Owner accepts G5; no open critical/high authority or data-loss issue; rollback and signing verified; claims match evidence.
stories.negative_cases: Tampered updater, unsigned artifact, private logs, broken uninstall retention choice.
stories.demo: Install/update/uninstall on supported OS and execute incident drill.
